entries.title: Applications page
entries.summary: Build application forms with questions, limits and accept/deny messages, then add them to any ticket panel.
items: 📝 The old Staff Applications tab is now **Applications**: build forms, set DM or website mode, questions with minimum length, accept/deny messages and a role.
🎟️ Ticket panels can use an **Application form** button.
⚠️ Picking a public channel as the mod log asks for confirmation.
🤖 New setting: Stop new bots on join (Protection & AutoMod).
fixes: Website applications now enforce the minimum answer length.

entries.title: Updates page
entries.summary: A new /updates page lists every new feature (kept for 30 days) with links to details, and the small fixes at the bottom.
items: 📰 New **/updates** page, linked in the menu and footer.
🧩 Premade, editable Updates and Bug fixes pages and emails live in their own group in the page and email builders.

entries.title: Smarter support helper
entries.summary: The support helper now knows every dashboard setting and page, the new applications and the bot gate.
items: 💬 About 6,000 more answers covering every setting and page.
🔎 Better matching for questions about applications and bots.
